title: Intraday Credit Facility Sizing Model
description: Models intraday credit facility requirements under the Basel III LCR framework and BCBS 248 intraday liquidity monitoring indicators. Calculates the minimum intraday liquidity buffer, recommended facility size with 20% operational headroom, LCR ratio impact from collateral pre-positioning, the full BCBS 248 ILM1–ILM7 indicator set, and peak debit stress scenarios at 1.5×/2×/3×. Outputs a facility adequacy assessment and AP2 JSON liquidity mandate. Scope: intraday credit facility sizing — distinct from Tool 42 (13-week rolling cash flow forecaster). Client-side. Zero PII.

avg_daily_gross_volume_usd.description: Average daily gross payment settlement volume in USD

peak_net_debit_position_usd.description: Maximum intraday negative balance — the ILM1 BCBS 248 indicator (daily max intraday liquidity usage)

buffer_target_pct.description: Percentage buffer above peak net debit for minimum intraday liquidity buffer calculation

current_lcr_pct.description: Current Liquidity Coverage Ratio as a percentage (≥100% = compliant)

current_hqla_usd.description: Total High Quality Liquid Assets stock (LCR numerator)

existing_intraday_line_usd.description: Existing committed intraday credit line amount

collateral_haircut_pct.description: Basel III haircut applied to pre-positioned collateral

time_specific_obligations_pct.description: Percentage of daily volume due at specific times (ILM4 input)

correspondent_flow_pct.description: Percentage of daily volume flowing through correspondent arrangements (ILM5 input)

payment_timing_first_2hr_pct.description: Percentage of daily payments sent in first 2 hours of settlement window (ILM7 input)

mcp_tool_definition.name: calculate_intraday_credit_facility
mcp_tool_definition.description: Calculates the recommended intraday credit facility size under the Basel III LCR framework and BCBS 248 intraday liquidity monitoring indicators. Returns the minimum buffer, recommended facility with headroom, LCR impact of collateral pre-positioning, ILM1–ILM7 indicator values, peak debit stress scenarios, and an AP2 JSON liquidity mandate. Use when a treasury or liquidity risk agent needs to size an intraday credit line for FedNow, Fedwire, CHIPS, CHAPS, TARGET2, or SEPA Instant settlement. Distinct from Tool 42 (13-week rolling cash flow forecaster).
